scope: Comprehensive actionable shortlist of KNOWN major candidate families from ICKSP, Raccolta 1857, Sensus Fidelium, Lasance, Baltimore and Pius X catechism. Not complete transcription of entire websites/editions.

policy.principle: Curated flexibility; useful alternatives can share a prayer moment and be selected in one tap
